messages:
maria (Partnerships): Quick kickoff for FortiCrypt marketplace onboarding. Key things: SAML/OIDC, SCIM provisioning, PKCS#11 HSM integration, cert/firmware rotation plan, and a short embargoed webinar plan.

evan (PM): Goals: 1) exchange SAML metadata + OIDC fallback 2) SCIM user/group + bulk behavior 3) validate PKCS#11 slot/labels + wrap/unwrap 4) cert/firmware rotation run 5) embargoed webinar + joint blurb.

lucy (Eng): From infra: please upload SAML metadata to an expiring signed link, include IdP certs, and give PKCS#11 slot ids and supported mechanisms (CKM_*). Also need p50/p95/p99 wrap/unwrap for KMS calls.

forticrypt (FortiCrypt): Uploaded metadata: https://partners.forticrypt/staging/idp.xml (48h). HSM attestation: FIPS 140-2 L3 bundle attached. PKCS#11: slot 0 (label "FC-HSM-1"), mechanisms: CKM_RSA_PKCS, CKM_AES_KEY_WRAP. Staging latency (wrap): p50=6ms p95=22ms p99=70ms.

sam (Security): Need IP allowlist template for SCIM callbacks, mutual TLS option for SCIM webhooks, signed SCIM JWT option, and a draft key policy for BYO-KMS. Also require a firmware rotation playbook before we enable Private BYO.

lee (SolutionsEng): Runbook skeleton I'll use for the smoke test:
1) create user via SCIM
2) assign group
3) create secret on FortiCrypt staging
4) rotate key using PKCS#11 wrap/unwrap
5) fetch secret from Redwood runtime and verify
I'll attach commands to the calendar invite.

lucy (Eng): Quick curl examples (staging):
```
curl -X POST https://scim.staging.forticrypt/v2/Users -H 'Authorization: Bearer <SCIM>' -d '{"userName":"rbx-smoke","emails":[{"value":"eng@redwood.com"}]}'
curl -X POST https://staging.forticrypt/api/secrets -H 'Authorization: Bearer <API>' -d '{"name":"rbx/smoke","value":"s3cret"}'
REDWOOD_SECRET=forticrypt://rbx/smoke node scripts/get-secret.js
```

legal-bot: Reminder: upload the partner MSA redline to /collab/partners/FortiCrypt and add approved co-brand phrases before the embargo window. Missing items will block the announcement.

maria (Partnerships): Action items:
- FortiCrypt: confirm metadata, attestation, mechanisms, telemetry, MSA redline (by EOD tomorrow)
- Lucy/Lee: finalize runbook + connector handling for Retry-After and PKCS#11 errors (by Mon morning)
- Sam: publish IP allowlist template, key policy checklist, and firmware rotation playbook stub (today)
- Evan: draft embargo window + webinar blurb (by Mon)
maria (Partnerships): I'll schedule a 30-min smoke-run Wed 09:30 PT to walk the runbook and sign off. Keep marketplace tile copy internal until Legal clears co-brand language. :lock:

forticrypt (FortiCrypt): Acknowledged. Our infra lead will join the smoke-run and provide VPN + cert details.

maria (Partnerships): Thanks all
